title: Femme de trente ans
html_source:
French. Woman who is thirty years of age. Figuratively, a woman of experience or maturity.

A reference to Shakespeare leaving Anne Hathaway in Stratford-on-Avon to make his career in London in the late 1580s. Hathaway was thirty years of age in 1586.

Perhaps a reference to the 1842 work by by Honoré de Balzac.
